verdict.rationale: AgentMail is email infrastructure for agents, so an AI inbox-triage story is a fair question for it. The evidence shows only primitives: string labels you attach yourself, allow/block lists, search, and webhooks. A developer could use these to build triage, but nothing shows AgentMail itself auto-labeling, categorizing or surfacing priority mail with steerable, auditable behavior.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, AI triages my inbox for me — auto-labeling, categorizing, and surfacing what needs attention — with behavior I can steer and audit
